text.en: Port engine design study: docs/62 §4. Schematic 32-second lift; linear interpolation; single-box continuous-flow capacities 30/24/18 boxes per hour; no delay, collision or interference physics. Counts are n20+n40 boxes and n20+2n40 TEU. Yard moves omit restoration.
text.zh: 港口引擎设计研究：docs/62 §4。32秒吊运采用线性插值；单箱连续流能力为每小时30/24/18箱；忽略延迟、碰撞和相互干扰。箱数为n20+n40，TEU为n20+2n40。堆场搬运不计复位。
